dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: #I'll be counting on you to help me gather inspiration again, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: How long will you be staying in Fontaine?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Huh. Well, I only just arrived, so I hadn't thought about that at all.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: I mean, I haven't even been to any underwater areas here yet! It's chock-full of amazing sights, or so I've heard.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: It's just that, ah, I need to learn how to dive for that. And there's so many things to remember... Ergh.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Guess it's best that I explore all the surface landscapes first.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Oh, right, and I do need to send a letter... I'm not going to get an earful about this, am I...

choices.text: Are your paintings a hit with the Fontainians?

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: They seem quite satisfied with my work, or so the feedback from the commissioning authors tells me.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: But coming to that, I must say that there are vast differences between novels from Fontaine and Inazuma.

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Especially when it comes to names! Remembering them has been so terribly taxing, so very vexing...

response.speaker: Asagiri
response.text: Alright, see you. I'm leaving the inspiration-gathering to you, alright?
